channel.title: Pier & Point · Uber Headquarters at 1455 3rd St
channel.description: Changes, corrections and dated milestones for Uber Headquarters at 1455 3rd St (Mission Bay), San Francisco. Every item names its source.

item.title: Correction · Uber Headquarters at 1455 3rd St: The old name, 'Uber Mission Bay 1', gave the…
item.description: The old name, 'Uber Mission Bay 1', gave the building a number that no source assigns to this address: Uber's annual report says only "We own two adjacent office buildings, Mission Bay 1 & 2" and does not say which is which. ArchDaily's project page, "Uber Headquarters", covers both buildings by address: "an eleven-story tower at 1455 Third Street and a six-story structure at 1515 Third Street". Both records now carry that name and their street address. Shape, status and use are unchanged; the old page address redirects to the new one, and the old name still finds the record in search. Source: ArchDaily, Uber Headquarters / SHoP Architects (https://www.archdaily.com/1006339/uber-headquarters-shop-architects): "an eleven-story tower at 1455 Third Street and a six-story structure at 1515 Third Street"; Uber Technologies, 2025 Annual Report on Form 10-K (https://s23.q4cdn.com/407969754/files/doc_events/2026/May/04/2025-Annual-Report.pdf), PDF page 103, Note 6: "We own two adjacent office buildings, Mission Bay 1 & 2".

item.title: Correction · Uber Headquarters at 1455 3rd St: The earlier row (2026-09-24) says the 2020…
item.description: The earlier row (2026-09-24) says the 2020 registration "predates the building's completion (ArchDaily lists the project as 2022)". The ArchDaily page is not cited or read. DataSF Registered Business Locations: "Uber Technologies Inc", 1455 3rd St, start 2020-06-25; "Bon Appetit @ Uber", 1455 3rd St floors 1 to 11, starts 2019-12-17 to 2020-10-27, ended 2024-01-01. The 2019 to 2020 registrations conflict with the reasoning that the building did not exist in 2020, so no completion year is given here and no source read dates Uber's move-in. The earlier row is left as written. Source: https://data.sfgov.org/Economy-and-Community/Registered-Business-Locations-San-Francisco/g8m3-pdis.

item.title: Correction · Uber Headquarters at 1455 3rd St: OpenAI's status at 1455 and 1515 3rd St stays…
item.description: OpenAI's status at 1455 and 1515 3rd St stays 'announced', a 2023 expected state from lease reports. Reports in 2026 say OpenAI now occupies more than 1 million square feet in Mission Bay and has subleased two buildings from Uber at 1455 and 1515 Third Street, but none names either building as occupied or gives a move-in date, so no opening is shown. The sources are listed in each record's open questions. Source: SF Standard, 2026-02-26 (https://sfstandard.com/2026/02/26/open-ai-mountain-view-expansion/); Hoodline, 2026-01-09 (https://hoodline.com/2026/01/openai-poised-to-gobble-up-dropbox-mission-bay-hq-space/); The Real Deal, 2026-03-16 (https://therealdeal.com/san-francisco/2026/03/16/openai-inks-another-mission-bay-lease/); SF Standard, 2023-10-27 (https://sfstandard.com/2023/10/27/openai-uber-headquarters-mission-bay/); DataSF Registered Business Locations (https://data.sf.gov/resource/g8m3-pdis.json).

item.title: Correction · Uber Headquarters at 1455 3rd St: The page shows two completion entries for 1455 3rd…
item.description: The page shows two completion entries for 1455 3rd St and they disagree: the Department of Building Inspection closed the new-construction permit on April 1, 2021 (a permit closeout date) and the Assessor lists 2021 as year built, while ArchDaily says the headquarters project was 'Completed in 2022'. Neither is picked; each entry is labeled by what kind of date it is. Source: DataSF Building Permits i98e-djp9, permit 201508245071 (https://data.sf.gov/resource/i98e-djp9.json?permit_number=201508245071); DataSF Assessor Secured Roll wv5m-vpq2, parcel 8721033 (https://data.sf.gov/resource/wv5m-vpq2.json?parcel_number=8721033); ArchDaily, Uber Headquarters / SHoP Architects (https://www.archdaily.com/1006339/uber-headquarters-shop-architects).

item.title: Correction · Uber Headquarters at 1455 3rd St: OpenAI was shown as open at 1455 3rd St on the…
item.description: OpenAI was shown as open at 1455 3rd St on the strength of a 2023 SF Standard report of a signed lease; it now shows the tenant as announced with no opening date. Uber was shown as open since June 2020 based only on a DataSF business registration that predates the building's completion, at a building later subleased to OpenAI; that tenant listing was removed, and the related timeline entry now describes it as a registration. The completion milestone said June 2021 with only a website's home page as its source; ArchDaily gives 2022, so it now reads 2022 (the status notes say the same, and that the Assessor has no year built). A pile-driver milestone sourced only to a website's home page was removed. The joint venture (Alexandria 51%, Uber 49%, formed September 2014) now cites Alexandria's 3Q14 supplemental, which also calls the two buildings Class A. The OpenAI lease milestone cites the SF Standard and Real Deal articles. Source: The San Francisco Standard, 2023-10-27 (https://sfstandard.com/2023/10/27/openai-uber-headquarters-mission-bay/); The Real Deal, 2023-10-29 (https://therealdeal.com/san-francisco/2023/10/29/openai-subleases-two-san-francisco-buildings-from-uber/); ArchDaily, Uber Headquarters / SHoP Architects (https://www.archdaily.com/1006339/uber-headquarters-shop-architects); Alexandria Real Estate Equities 3Q14 supplemental, SEC (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1035443/000103544314000075/a3q14-ex991.htm); DataSF Registered Business Locations (https://data.sfgov.org/Economy-and-Community/Registered-Business-Locations-San-Francisco/g8m3-pdis).

item.title: Added · Uber Headquarters at 1455 3rd St: SF Standard reported on 2023-10-27 that OpenAI is…
item.description: SF Standard reported on 2023-10-27 that OpenAI is leasing two buildings at 1455 and 1515 Third St from Uber, described as the largest office lease in San Francisco since 2018. The article reports the lease, not an operating office. Source: https://sfstandard.com/2023/10/27/openai-uber-headquarters-mission-bay/.

item.title: Added · Uber Headquarters at 1455 3rd St: DataSF Registered Business Locations lists Uber…
item.description: DataSF Registered Business Locations lists Uber Technologies Inc at 1455 3rd St with a location start date of 2020-06-25. A registration is not an opening, and it predates the building's completion (ArchDaily lists the project as 2022), so it does not show an Uber office opening there. Source: https://data.sfgov.org/Economy-and-Community/Registered-Business-Locations-San-Francisco/g8m3-pdis.

item.description: Uber Headquarters at 1455 3rd St: ArchDaily's project page gives 'Year: 2022' under the label 'Completion year of this architecture project' for the two-building headquarters (published September 4, 2023; a year only, no month given). item.title: Complete · Uber Headquarters at 1455 3rd St: Permit completion event: the Department of… (Apr 2021)
item.description: Permit completion event: the Department of Building Inspection records new-construction permit 201508245071 (filed under Assessor lot 033) as complete, with a completed date of 2021-04-01 (a permit closeout date, not an occupancy date); the Assessor roll for lot 033 gives 2021 as year built. ArchDaily gives 2022 as the completion year (see the 2022 entry and the open questions) (Apr 2021). Source: DataSF / SF Department of Building Inspection; DataSF / SF Assessor-Recorder; ArchDaily (architect-provided text), 2023-09-04.

item.title: Milestone · Uber Headquarters at 1455 3rd St: Alexandria Real Estate Equities and Uber… (Sep 2014)
item.description: Alexandria Real Estate Equities and Uber form a joint venture and acquire the 1455/1515 Third Street land parcels for ground-up development of two Class A buildings (422,980 rentable sq ft together); 15-year lease to Uber for 100 percent of the project (Sep 2014). Source: Alexandria Real Estate Equities, filed with the SEC (company-reported), 2014.
